properties.evidence: The same class from the other end, and linked rather than merged because the two halves are different and both matter. That fact measured a REPORTER who could not name the version it was talking to, and so filed a defect eighteen hours after it was fixed. This one measures the mechanism that PRODUCES that condition: replacing the binary never restarts what serves it, so the version a session reports and the version it is talking to diverge silently. Its own text already flagged this half as unaddressed — 'the same trap is live on this side, served_by.stale reporting a replaced executable' — and this is that half arriving as a field report from a real user on a second platform.
